title: Reporting a jam on a roller line

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: When a part jams on the roller line, notify maintenance right away. Give the line number and the last position reading on your screen. A position reading tells us where the part stopped. A motor current reading tells us whether the drive was under extra load. For a jam report, send both if the drive was still running. If it had already stopped, write that down instead of sending a current reading. We need to know what the drive was doing then.
turns.zh: 滾輪產線卡料時，請立刻通知維修。回報產線編號和螢幕上最後的位置讀值。位置讀值能告訴我們零件停在哪裡；馬達電流讀值能告訴我們驅動端是否承受額外負載。回報卡料時，如果驅動端仍在運轉，請兩種讀值都回報。如果已停機，請寫明當時已停機，不要附電流讀值。我們需要知道當時驅動端的狀態。
